title: design-kb: gate profiles
description: Named runs over the one gate inventory (design-kb.gates.json). A profile is an ordered list of steps; each step names the gates it uses, or is marked planned when its gate does not exist yet. Profiles share gates rather than copying them. Design scope: gate-experiment/query-layers-and-generation.md.

tiers.description: one = the run decides a single tier (or none, deferring to level); all = the run produces introductory, intermediate and advanced in parallel.

gates.description: Existing gates this step runs, in order.

planned.description: True when the step's gate or generator does not exist yet. A step with no gates must be planned.

change.description: What an existing gate needs changing to serve this step.

count.description: How many items the step produces (per tier when perTier is true); null when still to decide.

open.description: A question still to settle for this step.

continuesWith.description: Existing gates the run hands on to after its last step (e.g. the CRS / LES / WRA sequence).
